enemy.lead: Type an enemy name to see the items it drops per kill and their chances.
enemy.pick: Pick an enemy from the suggestions.
enemy.nodata: No data yet. Fetch it from "Data Update".
enemy.none: No drops of the selected kinds (adding kinds may show more).
enemy.footnote: Chances are per kill. The % in Table is the chance of rolling that table (mods, blueprints, etc.) and is already multiplied in.
